mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the next 20 trading days signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS declines below its 3-month moving average, or returns remain negative despite sustained FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% in the next month signals weakening labor market confidence, reducing corporate earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE exceeding 6.5%, or returns remain negative when UNRATE stays above 6.5% for the full horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in consumer demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) over the next 60 trading days indicates robust economic growth, boosting market confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST show upward momentum, or returns remain negative despite co-movement.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 98.5 in the next 5 trading days indicates weakening supply chains and manufacturing activity, leading to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite INDPRO falling below 98.5, or returns remain negative when the decline persists beyond the 5-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (evidenced by rising FEDFUNDS), higher interest rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS rising in a tightening cycle, or returns remain negative when FEDFUNDS increases above historical averages in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high unemployment (UNRATE above 5%) signals economic stagnation, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE remaining above 5%, or returns fail to correlate with sustained high unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises alongside consumer demand (GDPC1), it signals a balanced supply-demand cycle, boosting market confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and INDPRO show upward momentum, or returns remain negative despite co-movement.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates market uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE rising and FEDFUNDS declining, or returns remain negative when the interaction persists beyond the 60-day horizon.
